deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the authoritative thrower's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored throw-camera presentation marker index within the move instance.

triggerConditions: The deterministic combat kernel confirms the throw and emits its presentation marker.
The move instance and event index have not been consumed on the current replay timeline.
abortRules: Abort if rollback removes the authoritative throw confirmation.
Abort on round reset, match termination, or presentation-state teardown.
Abort if the source move instance is replaced before the marker tick; return through the approved gameplay pose without writing simulation state.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore the presentation-event cursor to the rollback frame.
Re-emitting the same deterministic event ID resumes or reconstructs the same tick-relative camera pose and never duplicates one-shot reactions.
If the event no longer exists after replay, discard it and use the approved gameplay camera pose for that tick.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Freeze attacker facing at the trigger tick and multiply lateral camera offsets by authoredFacingSign; do not mirror vertical or depth values.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: Blend for exactly 12 fixed simulation ticks to the approved gameplay camera computed from the unordered fighter pair.
visibilityRequirements: Attacker and defender roots, heads, and floor-contact region remain inside the safe frame with at least 0.8 world-unit root margin.
Neither fighter may be hidden by tribunal architecture, foreground decals, shadows, or stage effects.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the authoritative command-grab attacker's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored command-grab camera marker index within the confirmed move instance.

triggerConditions: The combat kernel confirms the command grab against a valid defender.
The authored camera marker is reached and its deterministic ID is new on the current replay timeline.
abortRules: Abort if rollback removes the command-grab confirmation.
Abort on round reset, match termination, disconnect, or presentation-state teardown.
Abort if either required entity becomes unavailable; never hold a camera on a stale render root.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore event cursor, captured facing sign, and elapsed camera tick from deterministic replay state.
Dedupe by the complete event ID so replay cannot restart impact emphasis or environmental reactions twice.
Recompute the constrained pose from serialized fighter roots at each replayed tick.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Author the track attacker-facing-right; multiply lateral X by the captured facing sign and keep both fighters' runtime mirroring independent.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: Use the standard 12-tick smoothstep-fixed-tick return and require both current fighter roots throughout the blend.
visibilityRequirements: Attacker and defender silhouettes remain complete through lift, impact, and recovery; floor contact is visible at entry and exit.
The defender may overlap the attacker as authored but may not leave frame or disappear behind the oculus, columns, or foreground.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the super attacker's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored super-camera marker index; full tracks require the move's approved confirm condition.

triggerConditions: The deterministic super state reaches its approved camera marker and any required hit-confirm condition is true.
The event ID is not already active or consumed on the current replay timeline.
abortRules: Abort if rollback removes the activation, marker, or required hit confirm.
Abort on round reset, match termination, disconnect, or presentation-state teardown.
Whiffed supers may use only their separately approved non-cinematic presentation and cannot promote themselves into this track.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore the event cursor and elapsed tick, then derive the same camera pose from replayed serialized roots.
Dedupe camera emphasis, stage reaction markers, audio cues, and flashes with the deterministic event ID.
Discard the track if the confirm disappears and transition to the gameplay pose appropriate to the replayed tick.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Mirror lateral offsets and screen-leading room from captured attacker facing; the beam or projectile direction remains combat-authored, not camera-authored.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: Return in 12 fixed ticks to the current gameplay camera and re-evaluate both-root containment every tick.
visibilityRequirements: Both fighters remain identifiable with the complete attack line or projectile travel corridor visible.
No stage emission, eclipse corona, or architecture may erase defender silhouette or active VFX.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the ultimate attacker's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored ultimate-camera marker index within the authoritative move instance.

triggerConditions: The deterministic ultimate state reaches its approved cinematic marker and required confirmation rule.
The presentation system has valid serialized roots for both fighters at the trigger tick.
abortRules: Abort if rollback removes activation, confirmation, or the cinematic marker.
Abort on round reset, match termination, disconnect, or presentation-state teardown.
Abort to the deterministic camera pose for the replayed tick; never complete an orphaned stage reaction.
rollbackReplayRules: Reconstruct track time from simulationFrame minus the event's authoritative trigger frame.
Dedupe all camera, light-response, and environmental presentation markers using the complete event ID.
Sample only fixed authored camera values and serialized roots; wall-clock time and random values are prohibited.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Author attacker-facing-right, mirror constrained lateral offsets from the captured trigger-facing sign, and never free-orbit across the combat plane.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: Blend for 12 fixed ticks from the constrained ultimate pose to the approved gameplay camera with both fighters contained.
visibilityRequirements: Attacker and defender remain visible through setup and impact, including the defender's resulting floor or airborne relationship.
Any full-screen treatment must preserve readable fighter silhouettes and cannot use the arena background as a substitute for required character visibility.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the authoritative round winner's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the round-end presentation marker index emitted after the result is locked.

triggerConditions: The deterministic combat kernel has locked the round result and winner.
The finisher presentation marker is emitted for the first time on the current replay timeline.
abortRules: Abort if rollback crosses before the locked round result or changes the winner.
Abort on match termination, disconnect, or presentation-state teardown.
Skip or shorten only when the authoritative match-flow state requests an immediate transition.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore the locked-result marker and event cursor from replay state.
The same deterministic ID cannot duplicate victory flashes, environmental reactions, or camera entry.
If the winner changes after replay, destroy the old track and instantiate only the newly emitted deterministic event.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Frame the winner from captured round-end facing and mirror only lateral composition; preserve actual left/right corner context.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: If another playable round follows, return in 12 fixed ticks to the approved spawn framing; otherwise hand off to the deterministic victory track without writing gameplay state.
visibilityRequirements: Winner and defeated fighter remain visible with floor contact and corner relationship legible.
The oculus may support the composition but may not replace, silhouette, or occlude either fighter.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the match-flow entity ID as sourceEntityId for the two-fighter intro sequence.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored arena intro marker index in deterministic match-flow order.

triggerConditions: The deterministic match-flow state enters intro before player control is enabled.
Both fighter spawn roots and the selected arena ID are finalized.
abortRules: Abort when match flow skips intro or rollback returns before intro entry.
Abort on disconnect, stage unload, or presentation-state teardown.
Fast-forward only on an authoritative match-flow skip marker shared by all peers.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore intro marker order and elapsed tick from deterministic match-flow replay.
Dedupe all stage reveals and character presentation cues by event ID.
A skipped intro remains skipped only when the deterministic skip marker is present after replay.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Use finalized P1/P2 spawn sides and mirror lateral moves when the match configuration swaps sides; do not change authored fighter-facing rules.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: Complete the final 12 ticks at the approved default gameplay pose before player control becomes active.
visibilityRequirements: Both fighters must be shown clearly before control begins, with P1/P2 sides and floor roots legible.
Arena reveal frames may temporarily favor environment scale only before both fighters enter; the final hold must contain both.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the authoritative match winner's stable fighter entity ID.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the match-result victory marker index after outcome lock.

triggerConditions: The deterministic match result is locked and exposes the winner entity.
Round-finisher handoff or match flow emits the victory marker.
abortRules: Abort if rollback crosses before the locked match outcome or changes the winner.
Abort on disconnect, stage unload, rematch reset, or presentation-state teardown.
Exit only on an authoritative match-flow transition; local UI timing cannot change the event identity.
rollbackReplayRules: Reconstruct winner, elapsed tick, and stage reaction cursor from replayed match-flow state.
Dedupe victory light response, banner motion, and camera entry with the deterministic ID.
If the match outcome changes, remove the stale victory track before creating the new deterministic event.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Mirror winner-leading lateral composition according to the winner's captured side while keeping the defeated fighter's real position visible.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: On rematch or next-round reset, use the final 12 ticks to reach approved spawn framing; otherwise the last pose hands off to non-gameplay match flow.
visibilityRequirements: The winner remains primary and the defeated fighter remains visible or clearly grounded in the same arena frame until the authorized transition.
Victory lighting and eclipse emission cannot erase either costume value range.

deterministicEventId.sourceEntityRule: Use the stable fighter or match-flow entity whose authoritative presentation marker requested the reaction.
deterministicEventId.eventIndexRule: Use the authored reaction marker index; reactionId is payload data and never replaces the event index.

triggerConditions: An approved deterministic presentation marker names an arena reaction ID.
The reaction ID is allow-listed and the complete deterministic event ID is new on the replay timeline.
abortRules: Abort if rollback removes the requesting presentation marker.
Abort on round reset, stage unload, or presentation-state teardown.
Silently reject unknown reaction IDs and any reaction that requests gameplay or camera authority.
rollbackReplayRules: Restore the reaction cursor and derive its phase from the fixed simulation tick.
Dedupe dust, banner, corona, light-response, and sound markers by deterministic event ID.
Use authored fixed curves or match-seeded values only; Math.random and wall-clock sampling are prohibited.
events.mirroredFacingBehavior: Mirror directional reaction emitters around the event source when facing-sensitive; arena-wide reactions remain symmetric and never alter fighter facing.
events.returnToGameplayFraming: The event never overrides the gameplay camera, so no camera return is needed; removing it leaves the current approved framing unchanged.
visibilityRequirements: The reaction may not occlude either fighter or exceed the foreground and VFX safety masks.
Attacker and defender visibility takes priority over dust, emission, banner motion, and light response.
